update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.1 - Stall fix for in-career event cutscenes
- Fixed the bot stalling on in-career story and support-card event "tap to continue" cutscenes (the Skip-pill screens that play before an event's choices appear). Both the between-run launcher and the in-career loop now tap through them to the choices, so events that used to stop an unattended run just resolve and the career keeps going. - Validated with a full 6-career unattended overnight queue that completed end to end.
